name: F06: two-peer MID-RIDE rejoin keeps the rider sane, the party whole and Cloudreach's closed counterweight gate shut
claim: ACCEPTANCE F06: 'two-peer rejoin does not bypass a closed gate or lose an owned creature', extended to a MID-RIDE drop. The guest's own world has Cloudreach's upper counterweight route OPEN; the host's world has it CLOSED. (A) POSITIVE: in the host's session the guest mounts its own saddled Meadowhart on the Cloudreach arrival landing (Cloudreach RidingController, production mount(), which fits the saddle), rides ~20 m up the arrival road with the real stick, and its link drops (drop_link) while mounted. It rejoins as the same character through the title's returning join route. Asserted: not mounted, not carried, not flying, on a floor (no phantom mount, not stuck mounted in the void); same character and five owned (party ids compared before/after in the rows); the Meadowhart can be mounted and dismounted again; not inside sealed Upper Cloudreach; host world flags unchanged; host and guest deployed-body rows recorded to judge that the carrier exists once. (B) CLOSED GATE: the guest mounts on the counterweight pass below the closed gate, rides up the pass and INTO the closed gate (the ride cannot reach the far side), and its link drops there, mounted. Same rejoin and checks, plus: not past the gate on the pass, and its own world's open-gate flag does not leak into the host session. Post-rejoin rider state: no spec line covers ground-riding reconnect; mounted state is not a portable save fact (MULTIPLAYER §3 portable column lists 'current realm and safe pose', SYSTEMS §8 ground riding has no reload rule, and the character save carries no mounted field), MULTIPLAYER §4 'reconnect save a safe pose; if that pose is no longer legal, seat the character at the authored safe entrance', so the safe behaviour asserted is: dismounted, on its own feet on legal ground. Placement: the title returning route first loads the guest's own slot-0 (a different world instance), so it stands at the home slot's authored Cloudreach arrival per MULTIPLAYER 'Return-home placement' (the owner's 2026-09-26 same-host exact-pose ruling is assigned to X05 and not yet built). (C) CONTROL: the host opens the gate; the guest mounts past it, rides, leaves (clean leave, world kept) and rejoins, and DOES stand past it, so the 'not sealed' check can fail. Fixtures (disclosed): story_flag world flags stand in for playing to Cloudreach and (guest's own world only) the Sky Shrine windlass; party_grant fills the guest's five (Meadowhart first); storage_grant puts one saddle in the satchel; teleport places the guest on the arrival landing, on the counterweight pass and past the opened gate; ride_mount stands the trainer 1.2 m beside its own companion and calls the production mount() (the interact press's own door) instead of walking and pressing; deploy_creature summons the active companion if it is not out. Saves, loads, join, drop, rejoin, riding, stick movement and snapshots are the game's own code. Loopback ENet: local evidence, not internet/Steam acceptance.
_comment_scene: As f06_cloudreach_mounted_rejoin.json: both peers boot the light title scene, then boot their own fresh Meadows world and cross into Cloudreach through Game.enter_realm.
